scenes.text: The four cardinal directions are north, east, south and west; a quarter-turn moves to the next direction.
Face east. Turn a quarter-turn left. Which way now? The answer is north. Use the compass order N–E–S–W; after turning, face north.
A learner faces east at a market stall and turns one quarter-turn to the right. Which direction is faced next? Pause to choose and explain.
A learner faces east at a market stall and turns one quarter-turn to the right. Which direction is faced next? The answer is south. Use the compass order N–E–S–W; after turning, face south.
